about: How code is coloured in The Ranch, the suggestion card and the source inspector. Read by public/code-syntax.js and desktop/CodeSyntax.swift, which must colour alike (test/fixtures/code-syntax-cases.json). Word lists are separated by spaces; where typesAfter is given, a built-in type name is coloured only after one of its characters, so `number` the variable stays plain. Colours are Xcode's default light and dark themes.
